title: Transition metal driven altermagnetism and spin–orbit coupling effect in tetragonal Ce-based pnictides: a first-principles investigation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,28405-28412
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02985J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Narayanan Namboodiri Puthusseri, Sambit Jena, Tanay Nag, Banasree Sadhukhan, Pankaj Bhalla
The study reveals a momentum-dependent spin splitting in CeCo2P2, indicating a potential d-wave altermagnetic behaviour. These findings highlight its promise for applications in next-generation spintronic devices.
